Name: Money Management Mod
Author: Tbonetomtom
Description:
[b][size=4]Intro[/size][/b]
The Money Management Mod is a mod that introduces changes to the game's currency system. It adds new features such as a public money system, tax calculations, and a HUD for displaying currency information. The mod allows players to transfer money between their personal account and the public account, set tax rates, and view their current balance in the HUD.

[b][size=4]Features[/size][/b]
Taxing: when selling stuff through the shop menu or the shipping bin. The mod will deduct a percentage of their profits as tax and add it to the public money account. The tax percentile can be configured through the mod's config file.

Transferring Money: Using keybindings, players can move money to and from the public money account. The default keybindings for "TransferToPublic" and "TransferFromPublic" are up arrow and down arrow, respectively. These can be modified using the generic config menu mod or the mod's config file.

Since this is my first mod, I anticipate many bugs. If you find any, please report them, and I'll do my best to fix them.

I made this mod because my sister used all the money to buy a "furniture catalogue"
